title: Leather Armour +2
summary: Light armour with 13 base AC and a Stealth bonus. Also improves Dexterity checks and saves.

fields.Armour Class: 13 + Dexterity modifier. Requires Light Armour proficiency.
fields.Acquisition: Levelled magic armour traders from level 7.
fields.Balance: +1 to Dexterity saving throws and ability checks. The ability-check bonus applies even when absent from the character sheet.
fields.Base value: 380 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
